fields.name: SqlShardConnectionOptions.SqlShardConnectionConfiguration shard connection configuration contract
fields.contract: SqlShardConnectionOptions.SqlShardConnectionConfiguration represents one SQL Server shard endpoint configuration through IShardConnectionConfiguration. Its ShardId identifies the shard, and it exposes separate ReadConnection and WriteConnection configuration slots. Consumers using the IDataConnection abstraction obtain the same objects through ReadConnectionInternal and WriteConnectionInternal, respectively.
